text_block_list.text:
While I'm walking around the academy
on my
lunch break...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
So sleepy... Training ran late again
yesterday, so I
shouldn't be surprised.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: UWAAAAGH! Cheer up, Taishiiiin!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: The hell?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey! Taishin! Have you heard about the musical Animal Kingdom?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
It's a musical! You know, those singing
plays!
Anyway, wanna star in one with
us?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Uh, no... Why are you even asking?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Musicals are excellent for training the
body. We
could start right now if you
wish.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
You're in on this too, Hayahide? Is this a
joke?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: A fun way to exercise, eh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Well, you're always training by yourself
at night,
right?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Isn't that kinda lonely and boring? I bet
it'd be
super fun to do a musical
together!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Musicals require a variety of skills in the

performing arts, such as singing,
dancing, and
acting.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's a fantastic full-body workout and
also serves
as practice for concerts—a
wonderful form of
exercise, don't you
think?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
...Nah. Sorry, I'm out. That's not really
my thing,
so you two go ahead and do
whatever.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hmm, very well. Then shall we give you
a little
teaser first?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Don't take your eyes off us! Let's
do this,
Hayahide!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: HIT THE MUSIC!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Wait... You're doing this now?!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит and Бива Хаяхидэ start

dancing... and dancing...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pfft! What the heck is this?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hayahide and her stern face in a
musical?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Heh... Haha! You've got to be kidding
me! Ahaha!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh! Taishin's LAUGHING!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Good! We pulled it off, Ticket! Mission
complete!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: M-mission? What are you talking about?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! Oh, Taishin! We know you've
been really
exhausted lately!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So me and Hayahide were thinking of
ways to
cheer you up!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
So how was that? Pretty entertaining,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Hang on a second. So you're saying
that...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
The whole musical bit was all just a
ploy?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
More or less. But I'm relieved to see you
smiling
as a result.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm! You had the hugest grin! Seeing you smile like that makes me so happy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Ugh! You tricked me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Just so you know, I filmed all of
that—including
Hayahide's emotionless
jig!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Might be good to get your sister in on
the fun... I
wonder how she'd react?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: E-excuse me?! Wait! Brian cannot see that!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yay! You two are having so much
fun
now! ♪
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
